t: Modular Widget Design: Enabling AI-Assisted Workflow Creation
s: The article details a refactoring strategy to break down complex widget examples into standalone, modular components to enhance AI-assisted workflow creation and system flexibility. It emphasizes clear organization and naming conventions for improved developer and AI comprehension.
sub: Refactoring widget examples into standalone components for AI assistance
Implementing a structured numbering system for plugin organization
Balancing UI manageability with the benefits of modular design
Leveraging development modes for plugin visibility
Establishing memorable naming conventions for AI and human readability
